assumptions: every site is locally satisfiable — WITHOUT this the ⟸ direction is false
attrs.evidence: Harary 1953: a signed graph is balanced iff every cycle carries an even number of negative edges, iff its vertices 2-colour. Exhaustive over 117,648 federations: 0 mismatches. The literal conjecture, stated without the antecedent, fails on 15,744 of them — an unbalanced split cycle sitting beside a locally unsatisfiable site makes fidelity vacuously true.
attrs.statement: At |D| = 2 over eq/neq, under the antecedent that every site is satisfiable, fidelity fails if and only if some split cycle is unbalanced in Harary's signed-graph sense (an odd number of ≠ edges).
